segment.description: Cane Creek (GNIS 01307376), the Buffalo-River-system creek whose course runs Hickman County into Perry County (HUC-8 06040004, NHD reachcodes 06040004xxxx, discharging to the Buffalo River) - NOT the Van Buren Co. Cane Creek of the Caney Fork basin, NOT the Putnam Co. Cane Creek, and NOT the adjoining Hickman Co. Mill Creek that TWRA stocks separately. Identity pinned by catalog GNIS/HUC plus NHD: gnis_id 01307376 resolves only to reachcodes under HUC 06040004 (Buffalo). TWRA's Trout MASTER layer places the stocked reaches in Hickman Co. at two gravel pull-off sites (35.6331,-87.6231 and 35.6482,-87.6604, the latter coincident with USGS station 03604200 'CANE CREEK AT FARMERS EXCHANGE, TN', 45.1 sq mi drainage) and in Perry Co. at 'Cane Creek Middle' (35.7041,-87.7558) and 'Cane Creek Downstream' (35.7091,-87.7745, coincident with TDECWPC-CANE004.1PE river-mile 4.1 and TDECWR_WQX-TNW000000900).
segment.boundaries: Catalog: 'stocked reaches in Hickman and Perry Counties', receiving water Buffalo River. Hickman stocked reach ~35.63-35.65 N (Little Lot area); Perry stocked reach ~35.70 N, river-mile 0.0-4.1 above the Buffalo confluence.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing Western Highland Rim tributary; no dam is documented on the stocked reaches in any source checked, and no spring influence is documented. Summer agency grabs on both stocked reaches read 22.0-23.5 C (see below), i.e. warm Rim stream behavior.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found in any source checked. TWRA's 2026 row-level schedule stocks this water only in late-winter/spring 'Seasonal' weeks (2/22, 3/22, 4/26/2026 in BOTH the Perry Co. and Hickman Co. 'Cane Creek' rows), a put-and-take calendar with no published between-stocking survival claim.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. TWRA's trout regulations page (fetched 2026-09-18) contains no entry for Cane Creek (Hickman or Perry) - no special regulation, no wild-trout listing; the page's only 'Cane' entry is the Caney Fork River tailwater and the only 'Piney River' entry is the Rhea County water.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: All three agency summer measurements on the stocked reaches read 22.0-23.5 C (Aug 2001 Hickman; Jun 2000 and Jul 2014 Perry) and TWRA stocks only in Feb-Apr seasonal weeks with no holdover, cold-source, or wild-trout evidence anywhere.
